title: Avaliação de diferentes protocolos para obtenção de Plasma Rico em Plaquetas para uso na medicina equina
author: Bernardino, Lucas Vasconcelos da Silva
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the whole blood sample at 100 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the resulting plasma layer at 175 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plasma again at 325 g for 5 minutes to obtain PRP.

steps.title: Record final cell concentrations
steps.instruction: Measure and note platelet concentration (~660 × 10³/µL), red blood cell concentration (~50 × 10³/µL), and white blood cell concentration (~2.6 × 10³/µL) in the PRP.
